Lingmo OS Windows Plugins.

- 代码仓库：<https://github.com/LingmoOS/lingmo-windows-extra>
- 许可证：`MIT`

## 构建

根目录 `CMakeLists.txt` 是顶层构建脚本（`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)`，`project(lingmo)`）。

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## 依赖

`debian/control` 的 `Build-Depends` 共 21 项，以下为前 8 项（完整列表见 `debian/control`）：

- `cmake (>= 3.16~)`
- `debhelper-compat (= 13)`
- `extra-cmake-modules (>= 5.102.0~)`
- `gettext`
- `kirigami2-dev (>= 5.102.0~)`
- `libkdecorations2-dev (>= 4:5.26.70~)`
- `libkf5config-dev (>= 5.102.0~)`
- `libkf5configwidgets-dev (>= 5.102.0~)`

顶层 `CMakeLists.txt` 用 `find_package` 查找 4 个包：`ECM`、`KF5KCMUtils`、`KDecoration2`、`KF5I18n`。
